subject: Staged discount ladder + operational milestones for renewal
messages:
From: Oliver Mills <oliver@cascadeops.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Kumar <asha.kumar@cascadeops.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion — discount structure and delivery milestones

Hi Olga,

Hope you had a great weekend. Our renewal is coming up in September and we need to lock a structure that balances price certainty with delivery commitments as we scale from proof-of-concept into production.

Numbers in short: baseline commit ~ $180k/month today; forecasted spike to ~$350k/month within 6 months based on new features. We need a predictable unit price for budgeting, and the procurement team flagged two asks: a timebound discount ladder tied to usage tranches, and a short-term price-hold while we validate performance on Private deployment.

Can Redwood propose a staged discount ladder (e.g., 10% at +20% usage, 15% at +50%, step-down clauses) and call out operational milestones (SLA targets, onboarding checkpoints) that would trigger the higher tiers? If you have a starter worksheet we can share with procurement, that'd speed approvals.

Attachments: CascadeOps_current_usage_Q2.csv (summary).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call this week.

— Oliver
Director of Platform Engineering
CascadeOps
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Mills <oliver@cascadeops.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — discount structure and delivery milestones

Hi Oliver — thanks for the context and the numbers.

We can absolutely model a staged discount ladder tied to both committed volume and specific operational milestones (e.g., Private deployment go‑live, 99.9% inference availability for the first 30 days post-cutover, and a successful QA eval across your top 10 prompts).

I'll pull a draft worksheet and a one-page term summary for procurement. For internal coordination, looping in Jordan (AM) and Ben (Pricing) so we can align on acceptable discounts and the operational gate definitions.

Proposing a 30-min slot tomorrow at 10am PT for a rapid alignment call — does that work?

Best,

Olga
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal discussion — discount structure and delivery milestones

Thanks for the loop, Olga. Quick notes from pricing and GTM POV before tomorrow's call: 

- Pricing posture: We can offer a stepped discount ladder tied to committed ARR and two operational gates. Proposed ladder: 8% at +25% committed lift, 12% at +50%, 18% at +100% (caps at 18%). These are contingent on a 12-month term.
- Price-hold ask: We can offer a 60-day price-hold post-signature for PV (private) go‑live testing; after that, standard consumption pricing applies with the ladder applied retroactively for validated months.
- Credits: suggest a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration costs (we recommend $25k in implementation credits, applied over first two invoices).
- Ops milestones: define three gates — (1) Private network egress validated, (2) Performance QA (p95 latency < 220ms at sample load), (3) Data & audit onboarding complete.

Ben — can you confirm whether finance will accept the proposed % bands and the $25k onboarding credit? Also whether we want to tie the highest tier to a 12-month minimum spend.

Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal discussion — discount structure and delivery milestones

Jordan / Olga — finance reviewed this morning. Outcome: we can approve the ladder and credits with the following adjustments: 

1) Ladder bands: 7% at +25%, 13% at +50%, 17% at +100% (final cap 17%).
2) Onboarding credit: $20k (applied as a credit over the first invoice).
3) Price-hold: 45-day price-hold instead of 60; any usage beyond hold period billed at published rates unless a PO is raised that extends the hold.
4) Highest tier requires a 12-month committed addendum (we'll draft a one-page annex).

Olga — I've attached a one-page term sheet and a sample worksheet I used with other customers (see CascadeOps_comms_breakdown.xlsx and CascadeOps_SOW_v2.pdf). Jordan — please use this when you speak to procurement.

If CascadeOps agrees to the changes, next steps: Jordan runs the term sheet with procurement, sign DocuSign annex for 12-month commitment if they want the cap, and ops schedules onboarding week for Private deployment validation.

— Ben
Director, Pricing & Commercial Strategy
attachments: CascadeOps_comms_breakdown.xlsx; CascadeOps_SOW_v2.pdf
